title: Python Memory & Bytecode
text: What file extension is used for compiled Python bytecode files created by the interpreter?
explanation: Python compiles source files (.py) into bytecode cache files (.pyc) inside the __pycache__ directory to speed up subsequent load times.

title: Python Immutability
text: Which of the following built-in data types in Python is IMMUTABLE?
explanation: Tuples and strings in Python cannot be modified in place once initialized; lists, dictionaries, and sets are mutable.

title: Pointer Memory Calculation
text: In a 64-bit architecture, what is the value of `sizeof(int*)` in C?
explanation: On 64-bit systems, all pointers (regardless of the underlying data type they point to) occupy 8 bytes of virtual memory address space.

title: Dynamic Memory Allocation
text: Which standard library function allocates memory from the heap and initializes all bits to zero?
explanation: calloc(num, size) allocates memory and zero-initializes all bytes, whereas malloc() leaves the memory uninitialized (garbage values).

title: Binary Search Time Complexity
text: What is the worst-case time complexity of Binary Search on a sorted array of N elements?
explanation: Binary search halves the search space at each iteration, yielding logarithmic time complexity O(log_2 N).

title: Master Theorem for Divide & Conquer
text: State the Master Theorem conditions and explain how it solves recurrence relations of the form T(n) = aT(n/b) + f(n).
correct_answer: Master Theorem handles recurrences with 3 cases comparing n^(log_b a) with f(n).
explanation: Critical B.Tech university semester exam question frequently tested in Design and Analysis of Algorithms (DAA).
